items.name: Don't Pause in Delhi 2026

venue.name: Bahawalpur Bhawan
venue.address: Bahawalpur Bhawan, B2 Janakpuri, Block B2, Shiv Nagar, Janakpuri, New Delhi, Delhi 110058

items.information: **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.** Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information. ### OTS Registration * On-the-spot (OTS) registration has been enabled for this competition. * All OTS participants are requested to come on time and follow the schedule. * OTS registration will be available from **9:30 - 10:00 am** * Registration for **7x7 event** is not available though OTS #### * **Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event under any circumstances if you reach late.** * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification. * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaldJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e4beb91f52394020fc106bedd27c9b53e250c044/scd.png)

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **There will be no 3x3 at this competition.** **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Whadjuk Noongar people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: Imagination Station B 2026

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information: This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission. Imagination Station opens at 12pm - you will not be able to get in earlier. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbWlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8843e254b05ca879fa0ab066c46e77b7920e76c8/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)

items.name: Victoria Winter 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.
